$source: Netra-Lab-Website: app/globals.css, lib/projectTone.ts, brand-guideline/Netra Lab.html. Copy values from here; never re-derive or re-shade them.

primary.role: Netra orange. The mark, 'Ours' in charts, badge fill. A fill colour: too light for text on paper.

link.role: Deeper orange for text links on a light ground.

foreground.role: Ink. All text; the ink colourway of the mark.

accent-maroon.role: Footer slab, primary hover, badge label.

card.role: Raised panels, screenshot stages, demo panels.

muted.role: Body prose on the ground, taglines.

muted-2.role: Meta, dates, table labels, chart spines.

tint-maroon.role: Project tone for large areas (Netra-NMT / MT).

tint-yellow.role: Project tone for large areas (other projects).

wash.role: Table header rows, hover. Never plain grey.

markColorways.orange: primary (on paper, on GitHub light and dark)

font.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
font.$note: Newsreader for headlines and prose, Kantumruy Pro for UI and every Khmer glyph. Don't add a third.

chart.$note: From Netra-OCR assets/CHART_STYLE_GUIDE.md. Baselines are deliberately off-palette: muted so they never compete with 'Ours'.

badge.$note: shields.io query params take hex without '#'.
